unit.name: Monkey D. Luffy
unit.summary: A medium-cost ranged damage unit inspired by Monkey D. Luffy from the One Piece manga continuity. His elastic Gum-Gum Pistol provides reliable single-target pressure, while three upgrade paths specialize in elastic reach and piercing, Haki-based control, or stamina-driven Gear attack adaptations. Gear techniques are represented as separate permanent attacks rather than runtime transformations.

rules: Cannot swim or operate independently while submerged; environmental handling is supplied by game context.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
actions.summary: Luffy stretches and slingshots an elastic arm into a ranged punch.

actions.name: Elastic Follow-Through
actions.summary: A wide elastic punch adaptation that adds a slower automatic burst of ranged pressure.

actions.name: Armament Haki Emission
actions.summary: Luffy projects a short-range beam of Armament Haki at a selected enemy.

actions.name: Conqueror's Haki
actions.summary: An automatic aura that periodically incapacitates nearby weak-willed enemies.

actions.name: Gear 3 Heavy Punch
actions.summary: An enlarged-force attack adaptation that delivers a slow, high-damage direct strike.

actions.name: Gear 4 Compression Burst
actions.summary: A compressed elastic projectile that trades cadence for a powerful long-range blow.

paths.name: Rubber Arsenal
paths.summary: Improves the Gum-Gum Pistol's damage, reach, projectile handling and target coverage, ending with an additional elastic burst attack.

paths.name: Haki Mastery
paths.summary: Adds Haki-based ranged pressure, improved Emission, target revelation and a bounded Conqueror's Haki control aura.

paths.name: Gear Techniques
paths.summary: Improves attack cadence and unlocks stamina-consuming Gear 3 and Gear 4 attack adaptations with escalating burst damage.

nodes.name: Elastic Force
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol damage from 3 to 5 hit points.

nodes.name: Extended Reach
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol range from 24 to 30 world units.

nodes.name: Slingshot Velocity
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol projectile speed from 34 to 48 world units per second.

nodes.name: Piercing Stretch
nodes.summary: Allow each Gum-Gum Pistol projectile to hit up to two eligible targets.

nodes.name: Elastic Follow-Through
nodes.summary: Unlock an additional slower projectile attack for sustained elastic pressure.

nodes.name: Armament Impact
nodes.summary: Unlock automatic Armament Haki Emission for an additional 2 damage per beam hit.

nodes.name: Emission Reach
nodes.summary: Increase Armament Haki Emission range from 10 to 12 world units.

nodes.name: Internal Destruction
nodes.summary: Add 3 damage to Armament Haki Emission as an offensive approximation of internal force.

nodes.name: Future Sight
nodes.summary: Armament Haki Emission also reveals its acquired target for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Haki
nodes.summary: Unlock an automatic 14-unit aura that applies 1.5 seconds of Unconscious to up to six weak-willed enemies every 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Gear 2 Circulation
nodes.summary: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol cadence by reducing its cooldown to 0.6 seconds while its stamina cost remains active.

nodes.name: Gear 3
nodes.summary: Unlock an automatic 12-damage heavy direct strike with an 18-world-unit range and an 18-stamina cost.

nodes.name: Gear 4 Compression
nodes.summary: Unlock a 18-damage compressed projectile with 32-world-unit range and a 24-stamina cost.

nodes.name: Rapid Gear Cycling
nodes.summary: Reduce Gear 3 cooldown to 3.2 seconds and Gear 4 cooldown to 4.8 seconds, increasing burst frequency at the same stamina costs.

nodes.name: Awakened Freedom
nodes.summary: Increase Gear 3 damage from 12 to 18 and Gear 4 damage from 18 to 27 as a bounded awakened attack adaptation without runtime transformation.

visuals.description: A cheerful young pirate captain with a straw hat, red vest, shorts and sandals.
A visibly stretched arm that snaps forward as the Gum-Gum Pistol projectile.
Darkened Armament Haki impact accents and a broad Conqueror's Haki pulse.
Distinct oversized impact effects for Gear 3 and compressed rubber projectile effects for Gear 4.

animations.description: Luffy pulls one arm back, stretches it, and releases it into a forward punch.
Luffy braces and projects a short concentrated Haki beam.
A pulse radiates outward from Luffy when Conqueror's Haki activates.
Separate heavy wind-up and release animations for Gear 3 and Gear 4 attacks.

audio.description: Elastic snap followed by a heavy punch impact.
Low resonant force sound for Armament and Conqueror's Haki.
Distinct heavy compression and release sounds for Gear attacks.

uncheckedRules: Character fidelity and prose/mechanic agreement require review.
The consuming game must implement these mechanics.
Runtime reachability, numerical balance and enjoyable progression are not established.

findings.evidence: Rubber Arsenal tier 3 claims to increase Gum-Gum Pistol projectile speed from 34 to 48, but its operations only set projectilesPerCycle to 1 and maximumTargetsPerProjectile to 1, both already at their base values. The projectile speed remains 34, and the diagnostic correctly marks this node as a near-no-op.
findings.change: Make tier 3 modify projectileSpeedWorldUnitsPerSecond to 48 and remove the redundant maximum-target operation. Tier 4 should remain the first upgrade that changes maximumTargetsPerProjectile.

findings.evidence: The supplied diagnostic reports a -0.054566 relative utility change from the base build to haki-mastery-1 across all six scenarios. The Haki beam also has a short 10-unit range and recorded targeting failures. This is measured scenario evidence, not a balance conclusion.
findings.change: Do not make a speculative numeric rebalance from the uncalibrated result. Test the action with enemies inside its intended short range before changing the Haki path.

findings.evidence: The diagnostic reports zero control signal and zero status uptime for the representative builds. Conqueror's Haki only selects enemies carrying the weak-willed tag, so the result may reflect missing matching targets in the supplied scenarios rather than an executable defect.
findings.change: Retain the weak-willed gate for source fidelity and test with game contexts that provide weak-willed enemies; do not broaden targeting without such context.

uncertainties: The Haki utility regression may be caused by scenario placement, target availability, or the uncalibrated diagnostic model; the supplied evidence does not isolate one cause.
The zero Conqueror's Haki control signal cannot establish a unit defect without confirming that the tested contexts contained eligible weak-willed targets.
No source evidence requires implementing Luffy's omitted resistances, runtime Gear transformations, or exact awakening behavior, and the contract excludes several of those mechanics.

limits: Source fidelity review remains model judgment. Diagnostics are uncalibrated mechanical evidence.
A rejected or failed review preserves the draft; structural success does not mean the review succeeded.
Only complete valid transactions are committed. Large redesigns and missing top-level structures may remain unrepaired.
Feasibility and source attribution remain model judgments. A supported claim in the plan is not an independent verification of the final implementation.

plan.identity: Monkey D. Luffy, One Piece manga continuity. Public design specification and feasibility report: proposed medium-cost unit at 600 credits, with damage and burst roles, one ranged base attack, and three independent five-tier paths. No manual abilities or encounter forms are declared; one automatic control mechanic and no damage-over-time mechanic are declared, for a prominent-mechanic count of 1/3 and native-active-­-

baseAttack.description: Gum-Gum Pistol: Luffy stretches and slingshots one elastic arm into a ranged punch. The base action is a single-target projectile with 24 world-unit range, 34 world-units-per-second projectile speed, 3 damage, and a finite one-target cap. It represents the attack directly, without implying a runtime Gear state.

paths.name: Rubber Arsenal
ownedProperties: Gum-Gum Pistol maximum targets per projectile
progression: Tier 1: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol damage from 3 to 5.
Tier 2: Increase Gum-Gum Pistol range from 24 to 30 world units.
Tier 3: Increase projectile speed from 34 to 48 world units per second.
Tier 4: Increase maximum targets per projectile from 1 to 2; every hit uses the same damage.
Tier 5: Unlock an elastic follow-through secondary direct strike against the acquired target, resolving after 0.2 seconds for 4 damage and one maximum target.

paths.name: Haki Mastery
ownedProperties: Conqueror's Haki aura and status action
progression: Tier 1: Add an Armament Haki secondary action after each successful Gum-Gum Pistol hit, dealing 2 additional damage.
Tier 2: Adapt that Haki action into a short 12-world-unit beam, with a 0.3-second windup and one maximum target, representing Emission.
Tier 3: Add 3 damage to the Haki action for an Internal Destruction representation; this does not claim armor penetration.
Tier 4: Add a 3-second reveal effect to the acquired target, adapting Future Sight into actionable target awareness.

Tier 5: Unlock an automatic 8-second Conqueror's Haki aura with 14-world-unit radius that applies 1.5 seconds of unconscious status to up to 6 targets carrying the supplied weak-willed tag; stacks are capped at 1.

paths.name: Gear Techniques
ownedProperties: Gum-Gum Pistol attack interval and cooldown
progression: Tier 1: Permanent Gear 2 attack adaptation sets Gum-Gum Pistol interval and cooldown to 0.6 seconds and spends 5 stamina per emission; it is not a runtime transformation.
Tier 2: Unlock an automatic Gear 3 heavy-punch adaptation: direct strike, 18-world-unit range, 4-second interval and cooldown, 12 damage, and 18 stamina cost.
Tier 3: Unlock an automatic Gear 4 compression-burst adaptation: projectile, 32-world-unit range, 36-world-units-per-second speed, 6-second interval and cooldown, 18 damage, and 24 stamina cost.
Tier 4: Combine the attack adaptations by reducing the Gear 3 and Gear 4 cooldowns to 3.2 and 4.8 seconds and their costs to 15 and 20 stamina; no simultaneous runtime form is created.

Tier 5: Apply a permanent 50% damage increase to the Gear 3 and Gear 4 burst actions as an awakened Nika-inspired attack adaptation, without implementing awakening, imagination-driven effects, or a form switch.

mechanics.name: Stamina strain resource
mechanics.implementation: Declared from placement with 100 starting stamina, 100 capacity, and 8 stamina regenerated per second. Gear 2 attacks spend 5, Gear 3 attacks spend 18, and Gear 4 attacks spend 24 before their later path reductions. If insufficient, the associated Gear action is skipped until affordable; no on-damage generation or unbounded secondary spending is used.

mechanics.name: Elastic follow-through
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Rubber Arsenal tier 5. A successful Gum-Gum Pistol emission triggers one declared secondary direct-strike action after 0.2 seconds. It has a 0.4-second cooldown, one target per emission, and 4 damage.

mechanics.name: Armament Haki impact
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Haki Mastery tier 1. A successful Gum-Gum Pistol hit triggers a declared secondary direct-damage action for 2 damage. Haki damage is an offensive representation only; defensive armor and Devil Fruit negation are not implemented.

mechanics.name: Emission
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Haki Mastery tier 2. The Armament secondary action uses beam delivery at 12-world-unit range, with a 0.3-second windup, explicit one-target cap, and no projectile-speed requirement.

mechanics.name: Internal Destruction
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Haki Mastery tier 3. Adds 3 direct damage to the Haki secondary action. The source distinction of penetrating and destroying from within is omitted because no penetration or internal-destruction effect exists in the contract.

mechanics.name: Future Sight reveal
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Haki Mastery tier 4. The acquired target receives declared reveal status for 3 seconds. This is a supported awareness approximation, not literal several-second prediction or guaranteed evasion.

mechanics.name: Conqueror's Haki
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Haki Mastery tier 5. An automatic interval aura repeats every 8 seconds after windup, uses 14-world-unit radius, targets only enemies with the supplied weak-willed tag, caps each emission at 6 targets, and applies unconscious status for 1.5 seconds with one stack and explicit expiry.

mechanics.name: Gear 2 attack adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Gear Techniques tier 1. Permanently lowers Gum-Gum Pistol cadence to a 0.6-second interval/cooldown and spends stamina per emission. It models rapid circulation as attack scheduling and resource strain, not as a runtime form or lifespan system.

mechanics.name: Gear 3 heavy-punch adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Gear Techniques tier 2. Automatic direct-strike action with 18-world-unit range, 4-second interval and cooldown, 12 damage, finite one-target cap, and stamina cost. It models enlarged high-damage attacks without body enlargement or post-use shrinking.

mechanics.name: Gear 4 compression-burst adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Locked until Gear Techniques tier 3. Automatic projectile action with 32-world-unit range, 36-world-units-per-second speed, 6-second interval and cooldown, 18 damage, finite one-target cap, and stamina cost. It adapts compressed release into a burst attack without a runtime inflated-muscle state or flight system.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 2, Gear 3, Gear 4, and Gear 5 as runtime body transformations or switchable forms.
omissions.reason: Unsupported by the contract because forms are external encounter selections and runtime transformations are excluded. Gear progression is retained only as permanent cadence or attack-action adaptations; no upgrade unlock is claimed to be a runtime transformation.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 2's possible lifespan shortening and its complete energy consequences.
omissions.reason: The finite stamina resource represents rapid energy consumption, but exact lifespan damage, long-term health loss, and canon recovery behavior are not supplied or implemented.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 3's original post-use shrinking and its later removal after the time skip.
omissions.reason: The implementation uses a separate heavy attack and cannot represent temporary body-size state or reversion under the form rules.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 4's inflated-muscle appearance, Armament coating as a body state, compression physics, and Moon-Walk-like aerial movement.
omissions.reason: Only the characteristic compressed burst is adapted into a projectile action. Appearance, live body state, special movement, and runtime transformation are unsupported.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear 5's fatal-blow trigger, white hair and clothing, awakened transformation, imagination-limited freedom, environmental or living-being rubberization, and joy-bringing aura.
omissions.reason: The final path tier uses only a permanent burst-damage adaptation. Triggered awakening, visual state, arbitrary imagination effects, environmental conversion, living-target conversion, and a general joy aura are unsupported or undefined.

omissions.sourceTrait: Rubber immunity to electricity, resistance to blunt force, vulnerability to sharp weapons, and loss of strength from water or Sea-Prism Stone.
omissions.reason: These are resistance, weakness, or contextual state rules. Generic stat modifiers are excluded, and no supplied game context defines the relevant damage tags or Sea-Prism interactions.

omissions.sourceTrait: Poison immunity with slow susceptibility to strong poison.
omissions.reason: The source does not define the full toxin scope or concentration rules, and resistance/immunity checks belong in supplied game context rather than invented unit mechanics.

omissions.sourceTrait: Armament Haki defensive armor, Devil Fruit-defense negation, and reliable contact with otherwise protected targets.
omissions.reason: The supported subset adds attack damage only; no target-defense or protected-target system is supplied.

omissions.sourceTrait: Exact Future Sight prediction, Internal Destruction penetration, and Conqueror's Haki effects on unspecified nearby people or animals.
omissions.reason: Future Sight is adapted to reveal, Internal Destruction to extra damage, and Conqueror's Haki requires an explicit weak-willed target tag. No unstated reliability, immunity, or target category is invented.

omissions.sourceTrait: Luffy's crew, family, fleet, affiliations, dream, liberation record, Emperor status, and bounty progression.
omissions.reason: These are narrative identity and world-context facts, not requested gameplay mechanics. No crew summons, economy system, roster interaction, or notoriety system is declared.

uncertainties: The 600-credit cost and all damage, range, cadence, stamina, status-duration, and target-cap values are neutral design parameters rather than source facts; balance is not established.
Conqueror's Haki requires consuming game context to supply the weak-willed tag and any status immunities or resistances. The unit does not invent boss immunity.
The supplied evidence does not provide complete named-attack, Gear 4, Gear 5, or Haki catalogs, so the draft deliberately implements a small supported subset.
Exact Gear 4 and Gear 5 duration, recovery, energy costs, and weaknesses are unspecified; the stamina model is an explicit adaptation.
The draft declares zero active abilities and zero forms, so the one-native-active limit and form lifecycle rules are satisfied without pretending that Luffy's Gears are encounter forms.
All secondary actions are finite-capped, nonrecursive, and declared as separate executable actions; no unsupported passive/reactive scheduler or manual status removal is used.

effectiveLimits.prominentMechanicCounting: Every declared ability plus every declared form plus one if control is used plus one if damage-over-time is used. Locked declarations still count. Resources do not directly count, but their associated abilities and forms do.

forms.requirements: empty; grant-form upgrade or explicit external unlock

effectiveLimits.formLimitations: Forms are external encounter selections. They do not switch at runtime, revert, enforce mutually exclusive modes, or make arbitrary combinations safe. A grant-form upgrade unlocks a later external build selection.
effectiveLimits.intervalCadence: For an enabled primary interval action, scheduled period = max(trigger.intervalSeconds, timing.cooldownSeconds). A fixed trigger interval can mask cooldown upgrades. A trigger floor of 0.15 seconds allows cooldown upgrades down to that floor; use a different explicit interval only when intentional. Windup delays resolution separately.
effectiveLimits.delivery: Direct-strike and line-strike can have range up to the same configured maximum as projectiles. Melee does not imply short range. Projectile primary aim count and collateral pierce are separate; do not infer a combined minimum target cap.
